cells.raw_text: Emesis, lethargy, abdominal distension, hematochezia, and fever

Emesis, abdominal distension, tachypnea, and groaning

Some of the intestinal tubes adhered in a mass, and pus was attached to the surface of the intestinal tubes; perforation of the ascending colon of 0.5 cm in diameter was seen 2 cm from the ileocecal portion
A huge 8 cm muscular layer defect of the gastric wall at the greater gastric curvature
Accumulation of free gas in the abdominal cavity

White blood cell count: 27 × 10⁶/L; glucose: 1.97 mmol/L; protein: 1,088.4 mg/L; nucleic acid testing: negative
HHFNC (for 2 d) + IMV (for 8 d) + nCPAP (for 1 d)
Dopamine (for 1 d) + dobutamine (for 10 d) + norepinephrine (for 5 d)
